factualAssertions.claim: Toy 90067 drops from NPC 66900 in the Niuzao Catacombs; interior location is map 389 at 65.6,23.8.
The Townlong cave entrance is approximately 32.8,61.6; the upper right passage leads to Huggalon.
factualAssertions.context: Multiple independent player location observations on the Retail NPC page, including recent confirmations; historical combat values were discarded.

facts.noAdditionalPrerequisiteClaim: The pinned Retail route has no quest, profession, faction or reputation gate. Nearby quest references describe navigation rather than a required quest. Actual enemy availability and combat suitability are not inferred.

opportunityRule.reason: No current per-reset loot cap is established. Do not mark a daily attempt from an unrelated completion flag.

nodes.text: Enter Niuzao Catacombs at the marked entrance in Townlong Steppes.

recovery.text: If the pin appears above or below you, use the outdoor entrance and follow the upper right passage. Do not infer a quest prerequisite from the nearby quest enemy.

destination.label: Niuzao Catacombs entrance
destination.directions: Enter the cave behind the area where Yul Wildpaw appears. Outdoor arrows stop at the entrance.

nodes.text: Inside the catacombs, take the rising passage on the right near the lower pool. Follow its right branch to Huggalon’s upper alcove.

recovery.text: If the pin appears above or below you, use the outdoor entrance and follow the upper right passage. Do not infer a quest prerequisite from the nearby quest enemy.

destination.label: Huggalon upper alcove
destination.directions: Continue through the catacombs. Near the lower pool, take the rising passage on the right, then its right branch. Huggalon is in the upper alcove; do not continue through the opening toward the lower quest enemy.

nodes.text: Defeat Huggalon the Heart Watcher and loot B. F. F. Necklace. He may appear neutral; a kill alone does not finish this step.

recovery.text: If Huggalon is absent, his next appearance is unknown. Choose another activity rather than following a guessed timer. If combat is unsafe, bring help or defer. Check the corpse and bag space after a kill.

destination.label: Huggalon upper alcove
destination.directions: Continue through the catacombs. Near the lower pool, take the rising passage on the right, then its right branch. Huggalon is in the upper alcove; do not continue through the opening toward the lower quest enemy.

nodes.text: Use B. F. F. Necklace in your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

recovery.text: If the item is missing, check bags, bank and mail. Toy Box ownership, rather than this guide cursor or the kill, completes the goal.

availability.reason: The local Blood Moon event must be seen. Its absence gives no verified next spawn time; this is not a calendar rotation.

requiredMaterials.name: Drained Blood Crystal
requiredMaterials.acquisition: Collect locally around Zeth’gol while the event is present. The amount required varies; do not reserve a fixed count.

factualAssertions.claim: NPC 91227 at Tanaan 22.2,50.6 is summoned by draining the Blood Moon and drops toy 127666; ATT marks the encounter daily with tracking quest 39159.
Drained Blood Crystal is item 122460 and comes from the surrounding event area.
Finish each crystal channel before moving or using another; nearby huts and ground provide further crystals.
factualAssertions.context: Retail item-page player observations; exact crystal counts, health and channel duration vary by patch and were not imported.

opportunityRule.reason: Use dated current-period evidence for a consumed opportunity; an undated permanent quest flag must not establish today’s kill or reward.

facts.automaticDetectionLimit: Crystal inventory and toy receipt are observable. A supported fresh NPC observation can establish the spawn; otherwise Continue advances only the cursor after the player sees the Remnant.

nodes.text: Inspect the Blood Moon in Zeth’gol. If the moon or its Remnant is present, continue; if neither is there, choose another activity.

recovery.text: The event has no verified next spawn time here. Do not collect against a guessed deadline or mark the event complete when it disappears.

nodes.text: Collect Drained Blood Crystals from the ground and huts around Zeth’gol. Start here, then keep gathering locally if you run out while draining the moon.

recovery.text: Search the surrounding huts and ground rather than expecting one object to be up at a fixed pin. Recheck your bags. The total needed is variable; one crystal is only enough to begin.

destination.label: Crystal search area
destination.directions: Search the nearby ground and huts around Zeth’gol for Drained Blood Crystals. Other reported search points are 22.2,51.3 and 22.0,49.5; these are search areas, not guaranteed spawned objects.

nodes.text: Stand near the Blood Moon and use Drained Blood Crystals. Let each channel finish. Continue gathering and draining until the Remnant appears, then press Continue.

recovery.text: If crystals run out, return to the collection step. Stop moving during each channel. If the Remnant is already up, proceed to fight it. Continuing records no summon, kill, unlock or ownership.

nodes.text: Defeat Remnant of the Blood Moon and loot it for Vial of Red Goo. The toy is a drop, so receiving it is separate from killing the enemy.

recovery.text: If no toy drops, keep the goal open and respect the observed daily loot opportunity. If the enemy is absent, inspect the moon again; do not assume another spawn or a fresh daily opportunity.

nodes.text: Use Vial of Red Goo from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Check bags, bank and mail if the vial is missing. Only Toy Box ownership completes the target; summoning, killing and daily tracking do not.

yieldGaps.reason: Variable crystal consumption and random drop; no exact deterministic yield/cap combination established for a forecast.
Drop chance, respawn and per-period opportunity count remain unestablished. No guaranteed completion date.

importerAudits.recommendation: Treat this source as phase/level uncertain until the exact merchant and offer are observed. Prefer separately authored capital-city vendor routes where eligible. Do not manufacture an exact maxLevel=49 from the approximate description.
